objections.claim: The governance bootstrap cannot satisfy the repository's existing deterministic gates. It must land AM-43 and sha-pin it in package-roots.json while withholding cli/, connectors/meta-ads-mcp/, inventory.mjs, test-inventory, and the other coordinated root surfaces until a later implementation slice. At that bootstrap head, either package-roots.json includes the two nonexistent/deferred roots, causing its required equality with inventory.mjs and test-inventory's exact discovered-package bijection to fail, or it remains on AM-42, contradicting the promised AM-43 pin and activation. A same-PR re-weave cannot repair those contract/inventory/package-set inconsistencies. Keep AM-43 authorized but inactive during bootstrap and activate/pin it atomically with both package directories and every coordinated root surface, or move that entire transition into the bootstrap; add an acceptance check that the bootstrap head itself passes the pre-existing verify-contracts and test-inventory gates.
